pin.estimand: Least-favourable mean token difference (Ainglish minus the shortest natural meaning-matched English exception clause) across cl100k_base and o200k_base on eight fresh operational scenarios.
admissibility_gates: Abort if either named tokenizer cannot be loaded.
Abort if the frozen set is not exactly eight unique, nonempty, within-pair-different items.
Abort if any frozen sentence pair duplicates an item in the target measurement manifest.
Abort if any tokenizer outcome is not a finite numeric value.

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.mapping: X holds for all cases except those named in L; naming the exceptions is part of the claim.
manifest.design: Independent fixed eight-pair settlement replication; fresh operational scenarios, equal weights, all finite outcomes filed regardless of sign.

manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, count Ainglish tokens minus baseline tokens; average equally within tokenizer.
manifest.analysis_plan: Headline is the least favourable (largest) tokenizer mean. Interval is the minimum and maximum item-level delta across both tokenizers.
manifest.test_set_note: Eight new meaning-matched sentence pairs fixed before tokenizer loading; no pair appears in the target manifest.
